Minesweeper is a game about a smiley.

At the top you see the smiley. You have 10 flags,

whatsnew.apps_body: “PC settings” is a second control panel, larger and shorter than the first, and every switch in it is real. “Miminus Store” is a catalogue of what is installed already. BOLGENOS cannot be installed.
whatsnew.both_body: Both Starts are here, and each one leads to the other: the menu has a “Start screen” entry, and the Start screen's app bar has “Start menu”. Which one the Start button opens is set in the taskbar properties.
whatsnew.charms_body: The right-hand corners slide out a strip of five buttons: search, share, start, devices and settings. Turning the computer off is hidden inside “Settings”, as it was in the original. So are working volume and brightness controls.
whatsnew.cover_body: Version 8. A flat look, a Start screen made of tiles, charms along the edges and a lock screen. The old Start menu has not gone anywhere — the Start button still opens it.
whatsnew.cover_title: What is new in MIMINUS OS 8
whatsnew.custom_body: Any library in the apps folder counts as a program, not only the ones that shipped. Drop your DLL beside the others — or in a folder of its own with whatever it depends on — and it appears in the Start menu by itself. What it declares is found by reflection once and remembered in the index. There is an example in samples/HelloProgram.
whatsnew.dnd_body: Files, folders and shortcuts move by mouse between the desktop and folder windows, and between windows. The drag belongs to the shell rather than to a window: a folder under the pointer takes the file, otherwise the open folder does, and an icon let go on the desktop lands where it was dropped. A mounted folder is renamed and moved on the real disk.
whatsnew.done_body: That is all of it. The system is still written from scratch, still contains no images and no sound files, and still finds no Popovs.
whatsnew.dpi_body: Choosing a DPI used to stretch the picture. Glyphs are now baked into the atlas at the device size: at 144 DPI an eleven-pixel Tahoma is drawn with sixteen real pixels and placed in an eleven-unit box. Icons are vector, so they grow with it and stay sharp.
whatsnew.dpi_note: Text is not stretched — it is rasterised again, larger.
whatsnew.dpi_title: The scale is a real one
whatsnew.folder_body: A folder called Windows refuses an ordinary delete. Press Ctrl — just Ctrl, no Delete and no questions — and it goes. The system carries on regardless, which was the point. The folder is on the desktop as well as on drive C:.
whatsnew.full_body: F11 fills the screen with a program, over the taskbar and without a frame; a bar with its name and a close button drops out of the top edge when the pointer goes there. Windows now open, minimise and close with an animation, and the Start menu unrolls out of the taskbar.
whatsnew.lock_body: A picture with a large clock and the date appears before logging on. A key, a click or a drag upwards gets rid of it. Win+L brings it back at any time.
whatsnew.look_body: The “Miminus 8” theme: not one gradient, not one rounded corner. The caption is flat, the frame is the accent colour, and the close button goes red under the pointer. Every older theme is still here, XP and “Miminus 7” included.
whatsnew.settings_body: The theme, wallpaper, language, volume, scale, refresh rate, smoothing and every taskbar checkbox are now kept in settings.txt beside the system — plain text anyone can edit. It writes itself whenever something changes and survives an update: there is still no Save button anywhere in this system.
whatsnew.setup_body: On a new machine the system asks first: which language to speak, what you are called, and how it should look. Five steps, and then the computer starts as usual. From this version the logon screen greets you with music written by the same synthesiser as every other sound in the system — its tempo changes every couple of bars.
whatsnew.stop_body: If anything in the system throws, MIMINUS stops the way the systems it imitates stopped: an invented stop code, the real exception type, its message and the top of the stack, a memory dump counting to a hundred, and a restart on any key. The crash command at the prompt raises one on purpose.
whatsnew.tiles_body: Tiles filling the screen, in groups, in solid colour. The clock, the antivirus, the weather and the store turn over and show something new. Any letter typed starts a search, and the right button raises the app bar.
whatsnew.title: What is new in MIMINUS OS
whatsnew.volume_body: Clicking the speaker opens the control: a slider, a mute box and the current level. The wheel over the speaker changes it without opening anything, and the right button gives a menu with the sound settings. Sliders everywhere in the system now jump to where they were clicked.
